noun_definition: Setting refers to a menu item in the application that allows users to share code.

menu item refers to the clickable element in the settings interface that allows users to perform actions, such as sharing code, but is currently unresponsive despite showing a pointer cursor on hover.
Pointer cursor refers to the visual indication that appears when hovering over an element, suggesting that it is clickable, despite the element being unresponsive to clicks in this context.
